description.value: An RV park and campground in the Okanagan-Thompson region of BC; no further detail is available as the website could not be retrieved. Amenities, access road, and pricing are unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides detailed amenity lists as primary evidence. I use website-listed amenities (flush toilets, showers, water on site, laundry, accept reservations, tenting area, WiFi) for all amenity fields, with OSM tags as cross-checks. The OSM address ('1-3169 10th Avenue') conflicts with the website address ('1-3169 Hwy 3 Keremeos, BC V0X 1N0'), so I use the website value and flag the discrepancy; phone numbers match across both sources.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists '1-3169 10th Avenue' but website states '1-3169 Hwy 3 Keremeos, BC V0X 1N0' — website value used and contact_confirmed.address set to false.
OSM name uses lowercase 'c' ('Eagle campground & RV Park') while website capitalizes it ('Eagle Campground & RV Park'); OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible campground with an active website confirming year-round operation and tenting availability in Keremeos, BC.
